name: sloppy
description: Spellchecks the prompt box as you type: misspelled words underlined, corrections in the typeahead, shift+arrows jump between them

color.title: Underline colour
color.description: The colour of the underline under a misspelled word: #rrggbb or a colour name such as red

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Spellcheck the prompt box; /sloppy on and /sloppy off toggle it too
